name: Prime Empire (Other story)
author: Asm0dey
description:
Final build 1.0
Lego ideas - Asmik1
On the home screen.
Short press on the spacebar - select a character. Available:
Long press (3-4 sec.) To confirm the selection and load the level.
In Game.
Single tap - jump.
Double tap in the game - double jump.
If you lose, then a short press will restart the level with the same character, and a long press will exit to the main screen.

If you do not press anything for a long time after a loss, then after 15 seconds it will automatically go to the character selection screen.
